thread:
michael.sec: Heads-up: new requirement for production database credentials and the IAM proxy. Effective 2026-10-01 we will enforce ephemeral DB credentials (1h TTL) for all services connecting to prod Postgres/Redis. Static DB usernames/passwords must be removed from repos and Vault by 2026-09-15.

michael.sec: Why: static DB creds are a persistent risk in leaked configs and third-party integrations. Ephemeral creds + IAM-attested minting reduces lateral movement and meets our upcoming compliance checks.

michael.sec: Timeline: announce now; discovery & migration window = 2026-08-15 to 2026-09-15; enforcement (deny-through-iam-proxy) = 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC. Post-deadline connections using static creds will be rejected at the proxy layer.

tara.db: Quick note: weve built a DB token broker service that mints short-lived DB users scoped to a role. Examples and SDKs for Go/Python/Node will be in the runbook.

michael.sec: Actions for teams:
- Search for static DB secrets: `git grep -n "postgres://" || git grep -n "REDIS_PASSWORD"`
- Remove creds from repo/Vault and switch calls to fetch ephemeral creds via our token-broker or the IAM proxy.
- For long-running migrations or queries, use the broker to request extended TTLs (max 6h) via approved exception.

infra-bot: scan-results: scanned 620 repos 93 found 34 repos with static DB URLs in code, 18 vault paths with plaintext DB passwords. CSV posted to #security-scans and owners will be DM[0m.

jason.sre: For on-prem clusters and customer-dedicated deployments where the token-broker can't reach the DB control plane, what's the path?

michael.sec: If the broker can't be used (private air-gapped infra), open an exception request with network-level mitigations (IP allowlist, mutual TLS) and a rotation plan. Exceptions are temporary (max 30 days) and require a named owner.

tara.db: Migration tip: start by instrumenting the DB client init to call `GET /token-broker/v1/mint?role=readapp` and cache the returned user/password in-memory for the TTL rather than writing to disk.

harry.cto: Important: infra teams, prioritize customer-facing services first. We'll escalate teams that miss the 2026-09-15 cutoff to eng managers.

michael.sec: Runbook & lib links: we'll publish migration examples, SDK snippets, and a Terraform module to wire IAM proxy rules by EOD tomorrow. If you need help, reply here and include the repo name.

jason.sre: Noted. We'll begin automated replacement on SRE-owned tooling this weekend and report findings.

michael.sec: Final: enforcement date again = 2026-10-01. Remove static DB creds from code and Vault, adopt token-broker or request a documented exception. Ping me for repo-specific help. :lock:
